description: Taskei P561614667: the number format and the displayed text Excel for the web gives six typed entries (12.5%, 12%, 0.5%, -$42.00, $42, -42). The value is in column B; the number format Excel picks is in the oracle's ENTERED log; the displayed text is the sidecar's `text`. The shapes are those of typed-currency-percent-input (T-0283), which logged formats and no displayed text.
